name: Lovo AI
tagline: Lovo (also known as Genny) is an AI voice generation platform offering over 500 voices across 100 languages, covering a wide range of styles, ages, and emotions. Its Genny editor combines text-to-speech with a video editor, letting content creators produce narrated videos without recording their own voice. Broadcasters, e-learning creators, and marketers use Lovo for voiceovers, audiobooks, and podcast intros. Its voice cloning feature can replicate a custom voice from a short audio sample.
